in_sanskrit.name: Neerav
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lotus-born
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Neerav एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Neerav is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Neeraja' which means 'lotus-born'. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often depicted sitting on a lotus flower. Therefore, the name Neerav symbolizes a divine connection to Lord Vishnu and the spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
